versions.changelog: Fix temp link support and banner removal

- Updated usage notes in SKILL.md to clarify that only Python scripts (Read, Write) are allowed; shell command execution is not supported.
- Small correction of the author’s display format.
- No changes to the core functionality or features.

Initial release of wechat-article-export.

- Export WeChat articles as long screenshot (PNG), PDF, or Markdown—individually or in combination.
- CLI and Python API usage supported.
- Long screenshots: mobile view, automatic image loading, hidden toolbars/elements, seamless stitching.
- PDF: converted from screenshots, with automatic white background and 100 DPI resolution.
- Markdown: high-quality output with YAML frontmatter, noise removal, syntax-highlighted code blocks, and flexible image handling.
- Supports trigger phrases and direct mp.weixin.qq.com links.
